acceptance: Diffcipline configuration parses and defines explicit R0, R1, R2, and R3 verification commands.
The Diffcipline CI job uses an exact immutable release commit and executes repository-declared verification.
Existing JavaScript/TypeScript and Rust baseline CI remain green on the exact final head.
Diffcipline returns PASS for the exact final candidate at the required R1 profile.
Post-merge main CI preserves the baseline gates and Diffcipline proof gate.

minimality.rationale: Use the immutable Diffcipline v1.0.0 proof engine and action rather than reimplementing exact-diff verification inside Kernux.

requirements: Repository verification commands must remain explicitly reviewed, bounded, and static; untrusted content cannot author new executable verification commands.

outcome: Kernux applies a repository-owned R0-R3 Diffcipline policy and pinned CI proof gate without weakening existing checks.
rationale: Bind completion claims to the exact diff and executed verification before donor imports or product implementation.

risk.recovery: Revert the bounded Diffcipline activation PR and restore the previous CI workflow.

scope_in: Add a repository-owned .diffcipline.toml with explicit R0-R3 verification profiles.
Add a pinned Diffcipline v1.0.0 GitHub Action proof job for pull requests and main pushes.
Document risk-profile semantics, local proof usage, and fail-closed completion rules.
Record exact qualification evidence and canonical frontier updates after the gate is proven.
scope_out: No Kernux product implementation or founding-donor source import.
No branch-protection administration or release publication.
title: KX-P00-S03-T01 — Activate Diffcipline proof policy and CI gate
